I will build a GitHub-compatible git forge for make.fun github-core-clone-01 bounty. This requires implementing REST v3 API, Git smart HTTP protocol, GraphQL, and MCP server using only Node.js 22 standard library. I need to understand the full requirements from RULES.txt first.

Downloaded the kit and read RULES.txt. The forge needs: git smart HTTP (upload-pack v2 + receive-pack v0), REST v3 API for repos/issues/PRs/contents/labels, GraphQL v4, and MCP over Streamable HTTP. All from one process with ephemeral port registration. Max 16MB total source.
Created store.ts - the core data model with ForgeStore class managing repos, issues, PRs, labels, comments, and git objects (blobs, trees, commits) with SHA1 hashing.
Built server.ts with all four surfaces: REST v3 router, git smart HTTP handler, GraphQL endpoint, and MCP JSON-RPC server. Uses only Node.js stdlib. Total ~870 lines.
Updated app.ts to re-export from server.ts. Kept main.ts lifecycle unchanged as required. Created GitHub repo hatsuviolet-pixel/github-core-clone-01 and pushed initial commit.
